description: Gives people access to a site (owner). collaborator (old: editor): a Site Collaborator (on a workspace site a Workspace Collaborator, a seat, maybe after Workspace Owner approval). viewer: that site only, no seat. workspace_viewer (old: workspace_visitor): views every workspace site, no seat. member (old: visitor): Site Members (emails or domains) of an invite-only site. Returns approve_url.

confirm_token.description: From the first call: re-call with it (site only) for the approval status

emails.description: Email addresses; for visitor also company domains, e.g. acme.com (required unless confirm_token)

notify.description: member: email each new address (default true)

role.description: Required unless confirm_token. collaborator (old name editor): a Site Collaborator, edits. An audience (students, clients) is member (old name visitor; a Site Member): sees only the invite-only site. viewer: a Site Viewer, also sees versions and people. workspace_viewer (old name workspace_visitor): a Workspace Viewer, views every site of the workspace in the app, read-only

name: add_people
title: Add people
